subject: Automotive & EVs
title: LFP: The Budget Champion
description: A micro-lesson that makes LFP: The Budget Champion usable.

hook.text: Lithium iron phosphate batteries use no cobalt or nickel—just iron, the cheapest metal on Earth.

buildup.text: LFP cells are safer, longer-lasting, and far cheaper than NMC, but they store less energy per kilogram.

discovery.text: BYD's Blade Battery uses LFP in a cell-to-pack design that closes the range gap with NMC.

twist.text: Tesla switched its standard-range models to LFP, signaling that cheaper batteries had finally become good enough.

climax.text: LFP now powers over half of all EVs sold in China and is rapidly gaining share worldwide.

punchline.text: Iron and phosphate proved that cheap can also be excellent.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of LFP batteries over NMC?
